#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

enum class Zone { OUTSIDE, INSIDE };

struct Counter {
    Zone zone = Zone::OUTSIDE;
    bool wordStart = true;
    int curOut = 0;
    int maxOut = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;

    void add(char c) {
        if (c == '(') {
            zone = Zone::INSIDE;
            wordStart = true;
            curOut = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            zone = Zone::OUTSIDE;
            curOut = 0;
        } else if (zone == Zone::OUTSIDE) {
            if (c == '_') {
                curOut = 0;
            } else {
                curOut++;
                if (curOut > maxOut) {
                    maxOut = curOut;
                }
            }
        } else { // inside
            if (c == '_') {
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                insideWords++;
                wordStart = false;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    string s;
    while (cin >> n >> s) {
        Counter counter;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            counter.add(s[i]);
        }
        cout << counter.maxOut << " " << counter.insideWords << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
